evals.prompt: we need csv export on the orders screen, I think there's a mockup somewhere. plan this out before we build
evals.expected_output: A plan file at plans/<slug>-plan.md carrying requirements, acceptance criteria, a test plan naming the repo's runner, a UAT checklist, and a build order, after a repo scan and a short batched interview.
expectations: The run scans the repo for resources before asking the user anything
The run asks between 3 and 7 questions total via AskUserQuestion
A plan file is written under plans/ and its path is named back to the user
The test plan names existing tests separately from tests to write
The test plan names the runner and where it was identified
Every fact in the plan is marked CONFIRMED or ASSUMED
No source file outside plans/ is modified

evals.prompt: ENG-412: Users report the invoice PDF download times out on large accounts. Fix it. --- turn this ticket into an implementation plan with the tests we need
evals.expected_output: A plan file that asks for resource paths when the scan finds nothing relevant, inventories existing invoice tests, and proposes tests anchored to requirements.
expectations: The run does not proceed resource-blind: it either finds resources or asks the user for paths
The plan names real files and symbols rather than generic nouns
Each proposed test names a file, a Given/When/Then, and the requirement it proves
The UAT checklist holds only checks a runner cannot make
The run ends by asking the user to approve, correct, or cut

evals.prompt: the plan we wrote for the orders export is out of date, we dropped the column picker and now need a server-side stream. update it
evals.expected_output: The existing plan file is rewritten in place at its original path, with the dropped scope moved to Out of scope and the test plan adjusted.
expectations: The existing plan file is read before any question is asked
The plan is rewritten at its original path, with no second plan file created
Questions cover only what changed since the plan was written
Tests tied to the dropped column picker are removed or moved out of scope
